# Hybrid

`sales.offering.hybrid` · offering_family · parent `—`

> Product plus attached service. The commercial trap is pricing the service as an accessory to win the product deal, then discovering the service consumes the margin the product earned.


## Characteristics

|  |  |
|---|---|
| delivery | artefact plus an engagement |
| pricing_shape | product subscription with attached implementation or success fees |
| margin_profile | blended, and only visible after the first delivery cycle |
| post_sale_load | moderate to high, and routinely underestimated at proposal |
